audit.whatIsWrong: Chart calls levels 4-5 and 6 even and gives Riven 2+ items; the packet chart and the audited Riven side both put levels 4-6 with Riven and 2+ items with Vayne.
audit.why: whys[3] and whys[4] already say her stacked Broken Wings dominates and Blade of the Exile adds range plus Wind Slash, while whys[6], spikes[3] and late all say Vayne takes the sidelane at two items. The chart is the only part disagreeing, and the packet flags it against a 52.5% Vayne win rate.
audit.corrected: Rows 3 and 4 to Riven, row 6 to Vayne, as one atomic paired group with ratings moved to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page names Ki Burst on every screen but never gives its range or cooldown, and Valor's shield is mentioned only in passing.
audit.why: Ki Burst stuns from 260 on 11/10/9/8/7s — she has to be almost on top of you. Valor is a 250 dash that blocks incoming damage on 10/9/8/7/6s, which is what eats the Silver Bolts burst. Broken Wings is a flat 13s covering all three casts, so the third knockback is the end of her engage, not the middle.
audit.corrected: Real ranges and cooldowns written into the cooldown block, report[5], report[9] and the Do's and Don'ts.

audit.why: Four spikes staged Lvl 3-5 / Lvl 6 / 1st item / Late, and the arc matches the corrected chart: her combo window, her ultimate, her item lead, then Vayne's two-item flip. Blade of the Exile at 120/90/60s and Wind Slash usable once per cast are both stated correctly.

edits.before: AA-tumble-AA on Riven's step-up, proc the third silver bolt for true damage, and walk away before he reaches you.
edits.after: Broken Wings is a flat 13s for all three casts and the third knocks back — once it is spent she has nothing.

edits.before: Riven wastes Ki Burst (Stun) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Ki Burst stuns from just 260 range and is down 11s at rank 1.

edits.before: That is Riven's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Valor's shield eats your burst window, so force the 10s E before you commit.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Blade of the Exile adds range plus one Wind Slash per cast.

edits.before: - Riven Ki Burst: matchup-defining — Her engage CC. Condemn the follow-up. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Ki Burst: 11s at rank 1, stuns from 260 — her combo starts here. - Broken Wings: a flat 13s for all three casts. - Valor: 10s dash and shield. - Blade of the Exile: 120s, one Wind Slash.

edits.before: Track Riven's Ki Burst (Stun): Her engage CC. Condemn the follow-up. When it is down — W-shred + kite her.
edits.after: Ki Burst stuns from 260 on 11s; Broken Wings is a flat 13s for three casts — Condemn her after the third.

edits.before: Commit on Ki Burst's cooldown, on your level-6 spike, and on your Blade of the Ruined King timing. His answer goes first; yours goes last.
edits.after: Commit once Ki Burst's 11s and Valor's 10s are both spent, on your level-6 spike, and on your Blade of the Ruined King timing.
